summary: Keep retained-removal report aggregation consistent and verify its eight controls independently in hosted CI.

replay.detail: No production replay, initialization, collector or writer activation.

schema.detail: No database, schema version, index, migration or persisted-format change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint and signed/current-key refusal producer rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The report builder consistently retains collected failures; the HTTP handler already computed its final aggregate. No additional wire, enum or strict CLI policy change. Missing removal evidence remains unknown.

downtime.detail: No additional daemon lifecycle transition. Source and selector validation do not establish runtime or filesystem latency.

manual.detail: The new hosted step selects exactly eight removal controls from the existing verified archive with zero retries and separate records. Original eight controls and operator behavior remain unchanged; no second compilation or local probe is required.

recovery.detail: No additional production mutation or rollback constraint. Actual control execution and broader signed-refusal/nonzero integration remain separately required.
